question: Is there any form in which the supremely free Lord cannot appear?
premises: The supreme Lord is full of freedom.
Because of that fullness he can accomplish even the most difficult acts.
His appearing is not limited by form.
inference: There is no form whatsoever in which the supremely free Lord cannot shine forth.
plain_english: Thus, because he is full of freedom and able to do even the most difficult things, in what form does the supreme Lord not shine?
